events.verdict: Sheppard (HOU) initiates contact with Zubac's (LAC) head as he defends the shot attempt.
Sengun (HOU) extends his left arm into Zubac's (LAC) vertical arm and initiates contact that affects his ability to defend the shot.
Durant (HOU) legally contests Harden's (HOU) jump shot attempt.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Harden (LAC) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Rockets.
Harden (LAC) dislodges the ball from Sengun (HOU).
Durant (HOU) legally contests Leonard's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Sengun (HOU) initiates contact with Zubac's (LAC) arm that affects his shot attempt.
Harden (LAC) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he moves to imminently guard an opponent.
Zubac (LAC) moves alongside Sengun's (HOU) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Zubac (LAC) legally contests Sheppard's (HOU) jump shot attempt.
Batum (LAC) contests Sengun's (HOU) shot at the basket and the contact after the release is marginal.
Dunn (LAC) initiates contact with Thompson's (HOU) arm as he defends the shot attempt.

Smith Jr. (HOU) wraps Zubac (LAC) and affects his FOM during the inbound.  Instant replay is utilized to determine if the foul meets the criteria for an away from the play foul.  After communicating with the Replay Center, it was determined the foul occurred after the inbound pass has been released, and the ruling of a common foul stands as called.

A replay review of the foul called on Smith Jr. (HOU) was initiated by the referees to determine if his contact to Dunn (LAC) met the criteria for a flagrant foul. Upon review, it was deemed that the contact was part of a legitimate basketball play and that there was no wind up and/or follow through after the contact, and therefore did not rise to the level of a flagrant foul.  Since whether the foul was correctly called and/or if there was a proximate common foul on the play are not reviewable matters under a referee initiated flagrant foul review, upon the outcome of the flagrant review, HOU challenged the foul call itself, which was unsuccessful; Dunn was deemed to be in a legal position when Smith Jr. turned into him with his arm. Contact by Batum (LAC) was deemed to have occurred after the foul call and was also deemed marginal.

Replay review of the foul called on Leonard (LAC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful.  Leonard extends his off-arm into Holiday (HOU) and initiates contact that dislodges him from his defensive position.
Batum (LAC) commits a take foul on Holiday (HOU).
Batum (LAC) steps over the baseline while he is still in possession of the ball during the inbound.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Rockets.
Batum (LAC) initiates contact with Sengun's (HOU) arm and affects his shot attempt.
Leonard (LAC) brushes Okogie's (HOU) shoulder as he releases away to receive the pass, and the contact is marginal.
